scenario_comparison.interpretation: Four separate synthetic outcomes under an unchanged algorithm. New scenario design is informed by earlier synthetic evidence; not an independent model-improvement confirmation. Full available populations remain primary.

formulas.tolerance: T_i = max(1 case, 0.20 × actual_cases_i); pass_i = 1 if AE_i ≤ T_i (numeric tie epsilon 1e-12), otherwise 0
formulas.within_tolerance: 100 × H / N, H = sum(pass_i), N = successfully produced forecasts
formulas.hits_all_requests: 100 × H / A, A = all requested target forecasts, including unavailable outputs
formulas.RMSE: sqrt(sum((prediction_i - actual_i)^2) / N); includes zero actuals
formulas.MAPE: sum(100 × AE_i / actual_i for actual_i > 0) / N_positive; exclude and disclose actual=0 targets
formulas.change: 100 × (future_estimate - previous_recorded_count) / previous_recorded_count only when previous_recorded_count > 0; descriptive change, not performance
formulas.interval: Nominal 95% SARIMA model interval from get_forecast().conf_int(alpha=0.05), not 95% forecasting accuracy; aggregate interval unavailable without dependence-aware calculation
formulas.splits: 80/20 uses 36/45 = 80% initial training and 9/45 = 20% h1 testing; 70/30 label uses floor(0.7×45)=31 initial months (68.89%) and 14 h1 targets (31.11%); h2 loses the last target origin
formulas.approval: Proposed demonstration measure. The panel accepted synthetic data according to the user, but no panel-approved accuracy formula was supplied. Within tolerance is not MAPE, 100−MAPE, an outbreak probability or future success probability.
